an9.25:1.1: 25 yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno paññāya cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti tassetaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno kallaṃ vacanāya
an9.25:1.2: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātīti.
an9.25:2.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhuno paññāya cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti
an9.25:2.2: vītarāgaṃ me cittanti paññāya cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti
an9.25:2.3: vītadosaṃ me cittanti paññāya cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti
an9.25:2.4: vītamohaṃ me cittanti paññāya cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti
an9.25:2.5: asarāgadhammaṃ me cittanti paññāya cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti
an9.25:2.6: asadosadhammaṃ me cittanti paññāya cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti
an9.25:2.7: asamohadhammaṃ me cittanti paññāya cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti
an9.25:2.8: anāvattidhammaṃ me cittaṃ kāmarāgāyāti paññāya cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti
an9.25:2.9: anāvattidhammaṃ me cittaṃ rūparāgāyāti paññāya cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti
an9.25:2.10: anāvattidhammaṃ me cittaṃ arūparāgāyāti paññāya cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti.
an9.25:2.11: yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno paññāya cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti tassetaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno kallaṃ vacanāya
an9.25:2.12: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātīti.
